answer_1.quote: ...knowledge-grounded dialogue generation aims to generate informative and meaningful responses based on both conversation context and external knowledge sources.... We evaluate the effectiveness of PLUG by applying it to an open-domain knowledge-grounded dialogue benchmark, Wizard of Wikipedia, and a knowledge-grounded conversational recommendation benchmark, REDIAL.

answer_2.quote: ...we report the performance with standard automatic metrics: BLEU-4 (B4), ROUGE-L (RL), and unigram overlap (F1) of the generated responses. ...we also report Knowledge F1 (KF1), distinct‑n (Distn) and recommendation item recall (Rec).

answer_4.quote: ...We conduct a human evaluation on Wizard of Wikipedia to assess the overall quality of the responses of our model compared to T5 and RAG. ...we hire workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk to rate models' responses on a 0-2 scale with three metrics: Fluency, Coherence, and Knowledge.
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate each model's response on a 0-2 scale for Fluency, Coherence, and Knowledge.
